title: tenant-key-proof-matcher-and-audit-chain-indexer
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: tighten cross-tenant KMS usage proofing and make audit trails queryable by residency cohort. Customers running Private/Dedicated deployments required clearer proof that tenant CMKs were used only for allowed regions and a compact index for retention-compliant audit queries. This PR introduces a tenant key proof matcher that attaches a verifiable proof token to KMS proxy responses plus an audit chain indexer that writes a compact, shard-friendly index used by retention/forensics jobs.

What this PR does: 1) Adds a lightweight proof matcher service in the KMS proxy that validates CMK origin, region pinning, and operator-scoped delegation claims; on success it emits a signed proof token attached as X-Redwood-KMS-Proof. 2) Extends the audit pipeline to consume KMS proof tokens and materialize an "audit chain index" document per request (tenant_id, service_zone, key_fingerprint, proof_token_hash, timestamp, residency_assertion). The index is optimized for time-range + residency queries. 3) Adds RBAC V2 policy checks at the service boundary to reject requests that attempt cross-region key use without resident consent. 4) Adds end-to-end tests, unit tests for matcher logic, and an integration test that simulates multi-tenant key routing + audit indexing.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-9345) [x] unit tests [x] e2e integration test [x] changelog entry [x] compatibility shim for older proxies [ ] manual rollout notes (separate follow-up)

High-level commits: commit 1: initial matcher implementation and interface definitions; commit 2: audit indexer writer and schema; commit 3: RBAC v2 policy hooks and negation tests; commit 4: tests + CI pipeline updates; commit 5: docs and release notes.

Files changed (high level): cmd/policy-enforcer/main.go - add hook into decision flow; internal/kms/proof_matcher.go - core proof matcher; internal/audit/indexer.go - indexer and writer; pkg/rbac/v2/matchers.go - residency-aware role checks; test/integration/kms_matcher_test.go - integration scenario; docs/security/kms-proofing.md - operational guide; charts/redwood-private/templates/kms-proxy.yaml - env toggles for matcher.

Backward compatibility and migration: matcher is opt-in via feature flag REDWOOD_KMS_PROOF=enabled. When disabled the proxy emits legacy headers unchanged. The indexer writes to a new audit-index bucket with lifecycle policies; operators should run a short migration job (script included in tools/migrations) to backfill proofs for the last 30 days if desired.

Security considerations: proof tokens are HMAC-signed with the service key and contain minimal claims (key_id, tenant_id, region, timestamp, nonce). Tokens are short-lived and are hashed before being stored in the index to avoid storing raw tokens. The RBAC checks enforce attribute-driven allowlists for cross-region operator roles to prevent lateral key use.

Operational impact: indexer writer is batched and rate-limited to avoid pressure on the audit storage service; charts were updated to add an autoscaling recommendation. Resource impact estimated: +0.8 CPUs and +1Gi memory per replica.

Follow-ups (planned): - rollout playbook and canary alerting docs - add optional KMS multi-provider proof translation layer - UI console view for proof-chain queries

Merge strategy: squash merge after final signoff.

release_notes:
- Add tenant key proof matcher to KMS proxy (opt-in via REDWOOD_KMS_PROOF).
- Add audit chain indexer for efficient residency and time-range queries.
- Enforce residency-aware RBAC checks at the service boundary.
additional_notes: Rollout: feature-flagged. Recommend staged canary across three regions (us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 secondary, ap-southeast-1 tertiary). Migration script located at tools/migrations/backfill_kms_proofs.sh. Ops runbook: docs/security/kms-proofing.md.
